rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=12, batch_size=1, lr=7e-05, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.7, wu_soft_thresh=0.0008, wu_sigmoid_slope=2.5, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-19 (one knob vs iter-18 best). NUMBERS sigmoid_slope: 10->0.30880, 6->0.30888, 4->0.30972(iter-18 BEST). Monotone improvement as the band roll-off shallows. FAILURE MODE: at ultra-low-param ceiling ~0.31; a shallower Nyquist-boundary sigmoid keeps lifting hr (softer band overlap -> the learnable per-band scales get finer spectral control). ONE KNOB: wu_sigmoid_slope 4.0 -> 2.5 (INIT, NO param change, 12 params). HYPOTHESIS: if slope=2.5 gives hr > 0.30972 the shallow-roll-off trend continues toward a broad optimum; if hr < 0.30972 the slope optimum brackets near 4 and iter-18 stands as the campaign best. Budget: ~735s.
